test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six boys Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil and Anil are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Rahul is fourth to the left of Anil. Ram is second to the right of Sohan. Ramesh is second to the right of Ram. Anil is not sitting on the extreme ends of the row.

Who is sitting second to the right of Rahul?
solution:
GIven: Six boys Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil and Anil. 

1) Anil is not sitting on the extreme ends of the row.

2) Rahul is fourth to the left of Anil. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44c514860edd09d4c6a9bb1beace5cc8df4d386cea04624edd93fa3756a14637.png] 

3) Ram is second to the right of Sohan. 

4) Ramesh is second to the right of Ram. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5541489cf6e9ae99f3073b35d5838973475a13673bbd6b5f71b5f478c1439678.png] 

And, Sahil will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/036f1d3e10f44e824d6671e08dd7ecc2031c729e99b733e9e8e458ffd722eda7.png] 

So, 'Sahil' is sitting second to the right of Rahul.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
